The '''TT-16B Master Powertech''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] used by both [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and other hired professionals alike during both [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. The highly violent Mandalorian Clan Chieftain, [[Mavrix Varad]], used the helmet of this armor while some non-Mandalorians such as thugs hired by [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] also used the helmet design before being killed by the [[Voidhound]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
